studybison._notes: Keep enabled=false until StudyBison has confirmed in writing that this integration and reuse of its data/media links is permitted. When confirmed: set enabled=true here AND set STUDYBISON_AUTHORIZED=true in the server environment (the proxy refuses to fetch otherwise). mode: 'proxy' (same-origin /api/studybison) or 'direct' (browser fetch; only works if StudyBison sends CORS headers for this origin).
